items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: They had another fella played guitar called Snow. His nickname was Snow, but I never did know his first name.

ctx.x: You wouldn't know, you knew both those guys, though.

Yeah, I know both of them, yeah. But he was a guitar player, and he'd sing and entertain, you know. Charlie. Yeah, yeah. And, uh, uh, Anderson, Tom Anderson, uh, is the biggest place I know the way they played at. Mm-hmm. Uh, uh, Walter Preston, and Tom Brown on a mandolin, well, he played mandolin like I was playing, and, uh, uh, Charlie Washington on a guitar, too. They had another fella played guitar called Snow. His nickname was Snow, but I never did know his first name. We used to call him Snow. They had two…
And that's all you ever knew?
